title: Cast
description: Reusable character entities for a narrative-film production. Principals are established early (locked for generative consistency); supporting/minor characters are derived from the script during breakdown.

id.description: Stable id referenced by scenes, sequences, and script

tier.description: principal = established early and identity-locked; breakdown = added from the script

identity_method.description: How visual identity is held. v1 ships prompt + reference_image; lora/rig are forward hooks.

reference_assets.description: Paths to provided/locked reference images (relative to the project dir)

consistency_anchors.description: Verbatim identity descriptors to repeat across shots for consistency
